component.name: Button
component.description: The system's clickable-action primitive. Covers form actions, card-footer approval, the floating new-task action, and icon-only utility controls.

commonPatterns.name: primary-cta
commonPatterns.description: The one main call-to-action in a dialog or view.

commonPatterns.name: approve-footer
commonPatterns.description: The full-width Approve action in a Card footer.

commonPatterns.name: icon-toolbar-action
commonPatterns.description: An icon-only action in dense chrome (dialog close, column header).

antiPatterns.scenario: Using appearance="primary" more than once in the same view
antiPatterns.reason: brand is reserved for the one deliberate call to action per view

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Button for navigation between pages
antiPatterns.reason: a button must not navigate via href
antiPatterns.alternative: Use a real link (SidebarNav item or an anchor)

antiPatterns.scenario: Using appearance="approve-ghost" anywhere other than a Card footer
antiPatterns.reason: it is reserved for the single Approve action and is always full-width

parentConstraints: size="icon" requires an aria-label since there is no visible text

interactions.hover: primary/FAB use a brightness(1.1) filter; secondary/ghost swap to a dedicated -hovered background token; approve-ghost gets a semi-transparent overlay tint
interactions.disabled: 0.5 opacity, pointer-events removed, native disabled attribute

aiHints.context: Use for any single discrete user-triggered action. Never for navigation or for communicating state with no action.
